studentText.conceptExplanation: This original MAIS chapter for Ratios, Rates, and Percent Reasoning connects Arkansas standards identifiers to student reasoning routines. The focus domains are ratios and proportional reasoning. Students work with concepts such as ratios, unit-rate, rational-numbers, expressions-equations, statistical-variability and practice competencies such as proportional reasoning, symbolic translation, data interpretation, model with quantities. The chapter asks students to name quantities, choose a representation, solve, and check whether the result fits the context.

workedExamples.title: Worked example
workedExamples.prompt: A school garden team uses 48 feet of edging for 6 identical beds. At the same rate, how much edging is needed for 12 beds?
workedExamples.solution: The unit rate is 48 / 6 = 8 feet per bed. For 12 beds, multiply 8 by 12 to get 96 feet.

workedExamples.title: Worked example
workedExamples.prompt: A school garden team uses 15 feet of edging for 3 identical beds. At the same rate, how much edging is needed for 9 beds?
workedExamples.solution: The unit rate is 15 / 3 = 5 feet per bed. For 9 beds, multiply 5 by 9 to get 45 feet.
